annotations.title: Meme coin logo / mascot image generator

description: FREE, no API key (about 100 calls/day). Returns a stable hosted URL for a 512x512 mascot-style coin logo (SVG) made from a ticker, name and theme. Styles: sticker, neon, retro, comic (SVG) or realistic (AI photo matching the name/description, cached). The same inputs always give the same image.

description.description: Optional coin description (used by realistic style)

theme.description: Theme words used to pick the mascot (frog, cat, dog, alien, ...)
